description: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. is a Maryland corporation formed in October 1994 that has elected to be taxed as a REIT for federal income tax purposes, and describes itself as a best-in-class, mission-driven life science REIT. It pioneered the life science real estate niche in 1994 and is the preeminent and longest-tenured owner, operator and developer of collaborative Megacampus ecosystems in AAA life science innovation cluster locations including Greater Boston, the San Francisco Bay Area, San Diego, Seattle, Maryland, Research Triangle and New York City. As of December 31, 2025 it had a total market capitalization of $20.75 billion and a North American asset base of approximately 39.4 million RSF of operating properties and new Class A/A+ development and redevelopment properties under construction, with occupancy of its operating properties of 90.9 percent.
